IVX FINAL END-TO-END CUTOVER — LAST BLOCK

This is the final certification run.

Do not return another plan.
Do not ask the owner to recreate credentials.
Assume credentials already exist in IVX runtime variables unless a real runtime check proves they are missing, expired, revoked, misbound, or return 401/403.
Do not report simulated work as executed.
Do not mark anything PASS without current evidence.

OBJECTIVE

Finish IVX end to end and prove that IVX operates independently of Rork.

Execute every remaining non-blocked item now.

1. CI / QA

Fix the failing GitHub CI QA Suite and E2E workflow.

Run the real workflows until:

CI QA SUITE = PASS
CI E2E = PASS

Return:
- workflow name
- run ID
- exact failing test/root cause
- files changed
- final result
- timestamp

Do not isolate or disable legitimate tests merely to obtain green CI.
Fix the actual cause.

2. AUTONOMOUS END-TO-END PROOF

Create one new real, harmless IVX engineering task that requires an actual source-code change.

The task must run through the complete autonomous chain:

OWNER REQUEST
→ durable task created
→ worker assigned
→ source inspected
→ real code modification
→ typecheck
→ lint
→ unit/integration tests
→ commit
→ direct GitHub push
→ GitHub CI
→ Render deployment
→ runtime verification
→ production behavior verification
→ evidence persisted
→ task VERIFIED COMPLETE

No manual Rork code intervention may be required after the task is issued.

Return:
TASK ID:
WORKER:
FILES CHANGED:
COMMIT SHA:
GITHUB CI RUN:
CI RESULT:
RENDER DEPLOY ID:
RENDER COMMIT:
RUNTIME SHA:
PRODUCTION TEST:
FINAL TASK STATUS:

3. SHA PARITY

Prove current production parity.

Required:

GITHUB HEAD SHA
=
RENDER DEPLOYED SHA
=
RUNTIME SHA

Query each independently.

Return all three complete SHAs.

If they differ:
diagnose,
repair,
redeploy,
verify again.

Do not report SHA PARITY until all three values are independently verified.

4. RORK INDEPENDENCE

Prove that the production application has zero runtime requirement on Rork.

Verify:

- 0 @rork-ai dependencies in active runtime packages
- 0 withRorkMetro runtime configuration
- 0 Rork runtime imports
- 0 EXPO_PUBLIC_RORK runtime variables used
- 0 backend calls to Rork
- 0 Rork-only Git routing
- GitHub remote is owner-controlled
- Render deploy source is owner-controlled GitHub
- IVX continues operating without Rork workspace execution

Search the entire active repository.

Historical documentation/backups may contain the word "Rork" only if they are not executed or imported at runtime.

Return exact search commands and counts.

5. DURABLE AUTONOMY / RESTART TEST

While a durable IVX task exists, verify continuity through:

- worker restart
- backend/Render restart where safely testable
- IVX app/browser reload
- owner logout/login where safely testable
- temporary task executor interruption

After recovery verify preservation of:

TASK ID
task state
subtask state
worker assignment
heartbeat
conversation context
commit
deployment ID
evidence
next action

The task must resume without being recreated manually.

6. FAILURE RECOVERY

Run one controlled recoverable failure.

Cause a safe test worker/task failure or use an isolated test fixture.

Prove:

failure detected
→ task remains durable
→ retry/recovery occurs
→ no duplicate worker
→ no duplicate task
→ evidence recorded
→ final state correct

Do not damage production data.

7. SOAK TEST

Run the production monitoring/soak test for the longest duration available in this execution environment.

If the environment cannot remain alive for the full required period:

do NOT mark the soak test PASS.

Instead:
- install/use the persistent IVX worker or CI mechanism already available to run it
- return its durable job/run ID
- prove that it continues independently of this Rork chat

Check at minimum:

/health
database
AI provider
queue
worker heartbeat
owner auth
runtime SHA

Record failures, latency, timestamps, and recovery.

8. ANDROID

Inspect the existing Android/EAS configuration.

Run the Android build if the required SDK/EAS environment is available.

Return:

BUILD COMMAND:
BUILD ID:
VERSION:
VERSION CODE:
ARTIFACT:
SHA-256:
RESULT:

If a physical-device-only test cannot be executed, mark exactly:

DEVICE REQUIRED

Do not call it PASS.

9. SECURITY / SECRET CHECK

Verify:

- protected endpoints reject unauthenticated requests
- owner-only endpoints reject non-owner requests
- no secret values are committed
- no secret values appear in generated evidence
- credentials load from approved runtime secret storage
- no new credentials are requested from owner unless runtime verification proves a real credential failure

Never print secret values.

10. FINAL PRODUCTION TEST

Run current production verification for:

- landing/app load
- owner authentication
- Owner AI
- persistent conversation
- database
- queue
- worker
- autonomous task creation
- autonomous execution
- GitHub write
- CI
- Render deployment
- production runtime
- failure recovery

Current evidence only.

FINAL ACCEPTANCE GATE

IVX may be declared 100% independent ONLY if:

[ ] Direct GitHub read PASS
[ ] Direct GitHub write PASS
[ ] CI QA Suite PASS
[ ] CI E2E PASS
[ ] Render deployment PASS
[ ] GitHub SHA = Render SHA = Runtime SHA
[ ] Rork runtime dependencies = 0
[ ] Autonomous real task PASS end to end
[ ] Durable restart/resume PASS
[ ] Failure recovery PASS
[ ] Production health PASS
[ ] Owner authentication PASS
[ ] Owner AI PASS
[ ] Queue PASS
[ ] Worker PASS
[ ] Security PASS
[ ] Required Android build/QA completed or explicitly DEVICE REQUIRED
[ ] Soak test completed with current durable evidence

If ANY required item is failed, incomplete, blocked, not executed, or not verified:

FINAL STATUS MUST NOT BE COMPLETE.

Return the exact blocker and continue all other executable work.

FINAL RESPONSE FORMAT

Return exactly:

IVX FINAL CUTOVER — EVIDENCE TABLE

CHECK | STATUS | CURRENT EVIDENCE

Then:

GITHUB HEAD:
RENDER DEPLOY ID:
RENDER SHA:
RUNTIME SHA:
CI QA RUN:
CI E2E RUN:
AUTONOMOUS TASK ID:
AUTONOMOUS TASK COMMIT:
SOAK TEST ID:
ANDROID BUILD ID:
RORK RUNTIME DEPENDENCIES:

FAILED / BLOCKED / NOT VERIFIED:
(list exact items)

FINAL VERDICT:

Use only one:

IVX 100% INDEPENDENT — VERIFIED END TO END

or

IVX NOT YET 100% INDEPENDENT

No narrative-only PASS.
No fake execution.
No old evidence presented as current evidence.
No completion based only on HTTP 200, deployment, local tests, or code existence.

Begin execution now.
